steps.title: Meeting the rebels
steps.text:
Talk to Eluned in Isafdar.
  • Chop magic logs nearby.
  • Kill a grizzly bear just west of Lletya if you need bear fur.
[Accept Quest]
Continue talking to Eluned.
Talk to Arianwyn.

steps.title: Mourners in the mountains
steps.text: Kill a mourner at Arandar.

Pick up all items the mourner drops.
  • Get 2 sets for Within the Light.
Read the letter.
Talk to Tegid at the Taverly lake.
Search the laundry basket.
Use the soap on the bloody mourner top with a bucket of water.
Talk to Oronwen in the Lletya clothing shop.

actions.text: I have all I need to mend my trousers.

steps.text:
Wait for the trousers to be mended.
  • Buy 3 of each dye from her.

actions.text: How are you doing with my trousers?

steps.title: Amongst the Death Guard
steps.text: Equip the mourner gear.
Enter the Mourners' headquarters in the north-eastern corner of West Ardougne.
Descend the trapdoor.
Talk to the Head Mourner.
Talk to the gnome on a rack in the west room.

actions.text: You said about toad crunchies and being tickled.

steps.text: Use a feather on the gnome.
Use a feather on the gnome again.
Talk to the gnome again.
Release the gnome.

Talk to the gnome after a minute passes.
  • Lobby if he disappears.

steps.title: Dyeing the non-dying
steps.text: Enter Rantz's cave in Feldip Hills.
'Unlock' the locked ogre chest.
Search the chest.
Exit the cave.
Use the bottle of dye on your empty ogre bellows. Use the blue dye bellows on the swamp toad.
steps.warning: If your ogre bellows is filled with swamp gas, use it on swamp toads until empty.

steps.text: Repeat the same steps with red dye.
Repeat the same steps with yellow dye.
Repeat the same steps with green dye.
Use a red toad on the fixed device.
Equip the fixed device.
Fire the toad at the sick-looking sheep (1) from the equipment interface.
Fire a green toad at the sick-looking sheep (2) from the equipment interface.
Fire a yellow toad at the sick-looking sheep (4) from the equipment interface.
Fire a blue toad at the sick-looking sheep (3) from the equipment interface.
Unequip the fixed device.
Return to the Head Mourner at the Mourners' Headquarters.

steps.title: Elena's advice
steps.text: Climb the ladder.
Take a rotten apple from the ground west of the headquarters.
Talk to Elena, north-east of Ardougne Castle.
Talk to Elena again.
Wait a minute or world-hop, then talk to her again.

steps.title: Preparing the poison
steps.text:
Pick up an empty barrel in the fenced-in apple orchard north-west of Ardougne.
  • Grab an extra if you don't have a barrel of naphtha.
Use the empty barrel on the rotten apple pile.
Use the apple barrel.
Use your barrel on the tar south of the Tirannwn lodestone.
Use your barrel of tar on the fractionation still outside of the Chemist's house.

Create a barrel of naphtha.
  • Increase the tar regulator twice.
  • Wait until the pressure valve is in the green.
  • Increase the pressure valve once.
  • 'Add coal' in 1-2 increments to get the heat valve in the green.
  • When the distillation bar is full, exit the interface.
Use the barrel of naphtha on the apple barrel, then use the apple mix on your sieve.
Use the toxic naphtha on any cooking range.
steps.warning: Do NOT use the toxic naphtha on an open fire or it'll explode.

steps.title: West Ardougne's woe
steps.text: Enter the largest building in the centre of West Ardougne.
Use one of the toxic powder on one of the grain sacks.
Climb up the stairs in the church to the south.
Use the toxic powder on the grain.
Return to the Head Mourner at the Mourners' Headquarters.
